description: This file contains a helper class 'ApiTokenHelper' that creates JWT tokens for testing purposes, with methods to generate tokens for admin and normal users.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate JWT tokens with predefined roles for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user with role 'Administrators'.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user with no specific roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with specified username and roles, signed with a secret key, and valid for 1 hour.
